about: STAGE-01 slice 1: language-neutral test cases for the Stage rules (reference: sim/stage.py). A port (Rust, JavaScript, Java, Ruby) passes when, starting from an empty state, it gives the same ok / public / private answers to each command and the same query results. 'director' is decided by the session's host, never by the command. Times are seconds.
